description: Reusable CLI tools and skills for Claude Code development workflows
name: agent-toolkit

plugins.description: PostToolUse hook that auto-formats files after Edit/Write using language-appropriate formatters (shfmt, prettier, markdownlint, google-java-format, ktlint, cargo fmt, taplo, ruff)
plugins.name: format-on-save

plugins.description: Desktop notification when Claude finishes a long-running task. Configurable threshold via CLAUDE_NOTIFY_MIN_SECONDS (default: 30s). Works on macOS, WSL, and Linux.
plugins.name: notify-on-stop

plugins.description: Work session management — start, end, checkpoint, handoff, resume, issue, reset, orchestrate, plus a model-triggered summarize skill
plugins.name: session

plugins.description: GitHub and Gitea tooling — unified CLI wrapper (issues, PRs, CI runs) plus a ship orchestrator that drives the full branch/commit/push/PR/watch/cleanup lifecycle
plugins.name: git-tools

plugins.description: Clipboard paste and screenshot capture for macOS, WSL, and Linux
plugins.name: image

plugins.description: Markdown linting and formatting — check, format, setup
plugins.name: markdown

plugins.description: Convert documents to/from markdown using pandoc (DOCX, HTML, RST, EPUB, ODT, RTF, LaTeX)
plugins.name: convert-doc

plugins.description: Bash command safety classifier with shfmt-based compound parsing, extensible custom patterns, and WebFetch domain management
plugins.name: permission-manager

plugins.description: Research-to-document automation — capture conversation findings as schema-valid markdown with frontmatter, linting, and optional commit
plugins.name: kb-capture

plugins.description: Pull/edit/push workflow for remote or privileged files — bridges SSH and sudo boundaries using rsync
plugins.name: elevated-edit

plugins.description: Configurable status line for Claude Code — git status, model, context, API usage, cost segments with ANSI colors
plugins.name: statusline

plugins.description: Analyze Claude Code session history for workflow patterns, friction hotspots, and automation candidates
plugins.name: session-history-analyzer

plugins.description: Java/JVM tooling — Maven Central intelligence, class search/decompilation (MCP via Docker), plus jar-explore for raw JAR content inspection
plugins.name: java-toolkit

plugins.description: Configure Steam games via SteamTinkerLaunch with automated system detection and template-based configuration
plugins.name: stl-game-config

plugins.description: IDE-grade code intelligence for agents — Serena (LSP symbol nav/refactor), ast-grep (AST search/rewrite), and Semgrep (security & dataflow) with usage cheatsheets, setup helpers, and a context-isolated explorer agent
plugins.name: agentic-ide
